newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish automotive output rises 14 pct in July.
newsitem.headline: Turkish automotive output rises 14 pct in July.

text.p: Turkey's motor vehicle output rose 14 percent from a year ago to 29,566 in July, the association of Turkish automotive industry (OSD) said.
Output increased by 16 percent to 193,532 in January-July this year, compared to the same 1995 period, OSD said in its monthly bulletin.
Leading the way was car production which stood at 22,090 in July, up 15 percent from a year ago and at 132,727 in the first seven months, up six percent from the previous period.
OSD said 120,173 cars were sold in Turkey in the first seven months of 1996, including 24,112 imported cars, compared to a sale figure of 110,295, including 8,040 imported ones in January-July 1995.
The share of imported cars in the domestic market almost tripled to 20 percent over the same period.

Seven-month output leapt 58 percent from the same 1995 period to 14,055 in trucks, 42 percent to 27,118 in tractors and 27 percent to 10,525 in pick ups. Bus production nearly tripled to 1,451 over the same periods.
OSD said Turkey's motor vehicle and automotive parts exports grew by 31 percent to $822.5 million in January-July.

Car exports totalled $199.9 million, up 65 percent from the same 1995 period, followed by bus exports worth $110.8 million, up 112 percent and tyre exports of $142.4 million, up five percent. -- Istanbul newsroom +90-212-2750875.
